title: Functoriality of the conormal sheaf of a closed immersion
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ and $i':Z'\to X'$ be closed immersions of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaves $\mathcal I=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ and $\mathcal I'=\ker(\mathcal O_{X'}\to i'_*\mathcal O_{Z'})$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and call $\mathcal C_{Z/X}:=i^*\mathcal I\;(=i^*(\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2))$ and $\mathcal C_{Z'/X'}:=i'^*\mathcal I'$ their conormal sheaves [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $g:X\to X'$ and $f:Z\to Z'$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $g\circ i=i'\circ f$. Then (1) the image $\mathcal I'\mathcal O_X$ of $g^*\mathcal I'\to g^*\mathcal O_{X'}\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal] is contained in $\mathcal I$, so $g^\sharp$ induces an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $\gamma:g^*\mathcal I'\to\mathcal I$; (2) the composite $c:f^*\mathcal C_{Z'/X'}=f^*i'^*\mathcal I'\cong i^*g^*\mathcal I'\xrightarrow{i^*\gamma}i^*\mathcal I=\mathcal C_{Z/X}$ is a canonical map of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules, characterized by: for affine opens $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subset X$, $U'=\operatorname{Spec}R'\subset X'$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $g(U)\subset U'$, $Z\cap U=\operatorname{Spec}(R/I)$, $Z'\cap U'=\operatorname{Spec}(R'/I')$, the induced map $I'/I'^2=\Gamma(Z'\cap U',\mathcal C_{Z'/X'})\to\Gamma(Z\cap U,\mathcal C_{Z/X})=I/I^2$ is induced by $g^\sharp:R'\to R$, which satisfies $g^\sharp(I')\subset I$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01R4 (morphisms-lemma-conormal-functorial), case of closed immersions (second and third paragraphs of its proof); the conormal sheaf of a closed immersion is Morphisms, Definition 01R2 (morphisms-definition-conormal-sheaf) and Lemma 01R3 (morphisms-lemma-affine-conormal)
